All jewelry is real silver with a few turquoise-enamel rings and pastel charms, sitting in real skin that is healed, clean and calm — no blood, no redness, no swelling, no wound — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Below the neck: from the collarbones down her body is not painted, covered or clothed — it is physically made of two solid transparent materials split down the centre, with nothing beneath and no skin anywhere.
